name: APU_7_Data_Exchange_and_Interoperability
title: APU.7 Data Exchange and Interoperability (Header)
description:
This category applies only if an app exchanges data with other devices, health apps, and/or HIT systems. If so, there are applicable
standards for data format, vocabulary, and transport, to increase interoperability and ease of connection.

statement.label: APU.7#93
statement.requirement: IF the app exchanges discrete clinical data THEN the app SHALL use standard terminologies (e.g., SNOMED CT, LOINC).

statement.label: APU.7#94
statement.requirement: IF the app exchanges discrete clinical data THEN the app SHALL use standard format/content (e.g., HL7 FHIR, SMART on FHIR, HL7 Consolidated CDA, Detailed Clinical Models / HL7 CIMI, etc.).

statement.label: APU.7#95
statement.requirement: IF the app exchanges discrete clinical data with devices THEN the app SHALL use standard format/content (e.g., IEEE 11073).

statement.label: APU.7#96
statement.requirement: IF the app exchanges unstructured data THEN the app SHALL use standard or commonly accepted formats (e.g., HL7 CDA, PDF).

statement.label: APU.7#97
statement.requirement: IF the app collects personal health information THEN the app SHALL allow data to be imported or exported from the app.[1]
